description: Vision of Voodress Level 60 You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be <class>! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring. As a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! Let it lift your spirits!
name: Vision of Voodress
